title: No override clears a factual failure
statement: Let a recorded human override settle a judgement call, but never let it clear a factual, safety or integrity failure.
detail: The student-course quality standard asks whether human decisions are explicit and accountable for every override, exception, acceptance, rejection or source choice, so that human judgment can improve a course without silently rewriting evidence (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/course-packages/quality/golden-student-course/versions/1.0.0/STANDARD.qmd`, lines 161-165). It accepts an override only when the record holds the original result, the final decision, its reason, who decided, a timestamp and the governed artifact, and it bounds every override: human override cannot erase factual, safety or integrity failures (lines 166-168).

evidence.quote: Human override cannot erase factual, safety, or integrity failures.
Learner outcome: Human judgment can improve a course without silently rewriting evidence.
Applies when: Every override, exception, acceptance, rejection, or source choice.
